name: wow-addon-dev
description: World of Warcraft addon workspace for Claude Code. /wow-addon-dev:init finds the addons already in a folder, declares them in addons.json with the client each one targets (read from the .toc), and wires up CLAUDE.md and .claude/settings.json. The workspace skill explains the layout and how to check a Blizzard API against the targeted client's UI source instead of from memory.
